title: Old-time pianists: Udell Wilson and the 101 with Lee Collins
summary: He recalls pianist Udell Wilson, who died in Memphis, and the 101 where Lee Collins played; he hung around but did not play there.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Any other old time pianist like that that you can remember when you were…
Old time pianist? Well, I knew, uh, Udill. You remember Udill.
I never met him. Udill Wilson was that…

He had his, his daddy was a preacher. I think he come from, uh, he was born in, uh, what's the name of that place again? Memphis. That's where he come from. And he went back to Memphis and he died. That's the last job they played when, which, uh, Lee Collins. Oh, yes. Lee Collins played there. I knew of a years ago. That's the 101 they called it, but it was, uh, and they called it the Entertainer. And they called it the 101.
Did you play there with, uh, that group ever?

No, I used to pass there and, uh, talk to them and stay there and hang around there. When I used to get off, stay there all night hanging around there with them and leave there and go eatin', you know, and breakfast and stuff. I know them though. They always livin' around where I was livin'.
